Done. `scripts/sync.sh` now accepts a `--verbose` flag (before or after the destination):

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Copies notes/ into DEST.
# Usage: sync.sh [--verbose] DEST
set -e
verbose=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --verbose) verbose=1 ;;
    *) dest="$arg" ;;
  esac
done
for f in notes/*; do
  if [ "$verbose" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '%s -> %s\n' "$f" "$dest/"
  fi
  cp "$f" "$dest/"
done
```
